title: T13 Basys 3 top-level protocol and localization integration contract

modules.name: protocol_command_adapter
behavior: Read payload bytes only while packet_decoder holds a CRC-valid frame.
Validate exact SET_CONFIG, complete LOAD_OBSERVATIONS, and READ_RESULT paging fields.
Buffer every observation locally and write the controller staging area only after full semantic validation.
Hold a semantic command or local error until the selected downstream consumer accepts it.
constraints: Payload bytes are little-endian and maximum length is 244 bytes.
corner_cases: Reserved bits, high phase bits, invalid count, invalid length, and invalid result kind are rejected without command commit.
verification_cases: Exact and mismatched config, two observations, result-header and vertex-page requests.

timing_diagrams.title: Validated observation commit
timing_diagrams.description: Read and validate the held frame before staging writes and command commit.

modules.name: protocol_response_adapter
behavior: Snapshot response and result fields before transmission.
Render all T03 response payload formats byte-by-byte in little-endian order.
Convert a valid vertex request into RESULT_VERTICES and prefetch each synchronous RAM word.
Convert an unavailable vertex range into RESULT_UNAVAILABLE.
constraints: Vertex chunks contain one through sixteen vertices and fit the 244-byte payload limit.
corner_cases: A final short page returns only remaining vertices; a start index at or above count returns ERROR.
verification_cases: INFO, ACK, STATUS, ERROR, result header, four-vertex page, and unavailable page.

timing_diagrams.title: Vertex page response
timing_diagrams.description: Descriptor capture starts a RAM prefetch before payload demand.

modules.name: radio_localization_fpga_top
behavior: Connect UART, packet decoder, semantic command adapter, localization controller, response adapter, packet encoder, and UART transmitter.
Prioritize decoder errors, semantic errors, and controller responses into one held response channel.
Drive idle, receive, compute, and latched error LEDs and pulse debug_trigger_o on job completion.
constraints: Basys 3 pins and the 10 ns primary clock are defined by constraints/basys3_radio_localization.xdc.
corner_cases: A CRC error is returned and the next valid frame resynchronizes without reset.
verification_cases: Real serial GET_INFO through result paging, invalid configuration, CRC error, and post-error resynchronization.

timing_diagrams.title: Complete UART localization job
timing_diagrams.description: Commands and responses surround one geometry computation and paged result read.
